piece.headline: Ayodele hits back as Cherag's cushion thins
piece.standfirst: Ayodele's armband on Haaland landed the week's best score. Cherag still leads, but only by 9.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Edd and Hishaan both gave Palmer the armband over Haaland. It returned -2, against 16 for Haaland. Bold call, bad week for it.
piece.one_to_watch: Cherag leads Ayodele by 9. If João Pedro blanks again under Cherag's armband, that gap could shrink further.

winners.name: Ayodele
winners.verdict: Backed Haaland and banked the armband haul. Best score in the league. Cherag now has company in the title race.

winners.name: Tomisin
winners.verdict: Haaland's armband gave him 16 and a climb to 17th. Not a glamorous place, but it's the right direction. Sensible, and it paid.

winners.name: Dominic
winners.verdict: João Pedro blanked as his captain. Dominic still climbed 6 places. The rest of his squad did the heavy lifting.

losers.name: Hishaan
losers.verdict: Palmer got the armband over Haaland and returned -2. Hishaan picked the wrong one, and slid 4 places.
